concerns.text: The plan relies on a synthetic dataset generated locally (see “If an open dataset were available, we would stream it, but in the current plan we generate a synthetic dataset on‑the‑fly”) instead of the required OpenML BFI‑2 and Last.fm listening archives mandated by FR‑001. Synthetic data cannot answer the real‑world correlation research question, making the dataset choice inappropriate for the study’s objectives.
